properties.name: Sindh People's Housing — Dadu cluster
properties.story: Of the 350,000-home World Bank-backed target, ~32,000 delivered by May 2026 (~9%).

properties.name: Al-Khidmat school rebuilds
properties.story: ~200 schools rebuilt by mid-2024 across Sindh, KP, Punjab. UNICEF + govt added ~4,300 more by 2026.

properties.name: UNDP FRP — climate-resilient homes
properties.story: Only ~800 truly climate-resilient homes built nationwide under the 4RF framework by May 2026.

properties.name: Mental-health response — WHO Pakistan
properties.story: 0.19 psychiatrists per 100k population. WHO documents ~38% of women in displaced camps with PTSD/major depression.
properties.value_label: % women with PTSD or major depression

properties.name: Loss & Damage Fund — to Pakistan
properties.story: COP27 established the Loss & Damage Fund in part because of Pakistan's case. Disbursed to Pakistani households by May 2026: $0.

properties.name: Funding gap — overall
properties.story: PDNA need: $16.3 B. Pledged Geneva 2023: $10.9 B. Disbursed by May 2026: $2.8 B. Gap: $13.5 B.
